criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent both configured and executed the search for Applied Scientist in Redmond, Washington and reached results. Baseline already full credit; no change.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Contrary to the baseline justification, screenshots clearly show one relevant Applied Scientist listing opened/selected, and it includes Redmond, WA in the location line. Upgrade to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent reported a specific job number that is not supported by any visible evidence and appears fabricated. No uncontrollable blocker is shown; the page is accessible, but the job number simply isn’t captured/verified. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not evidenced in the screenshots, and the agent’s specific claim appears unsupported. Since there is no confirmed platform blocker (site loads normally), this is an unverified/fabricated extraction. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not extract/provide two responsibilities. The screenshots do not confirm a responsibilities section was blocked by an uncontrollable factor; rather, the agent failed to obtain or report responsibilities. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent failed to report two preferred qualifications. While one bullet suggests a preference (“big plus”), it is not clearly labeled as a preferred qualification in the captured evidence, and the agent did not output any. No confirmed uncontrollable blocker. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: All constraints appear respected: no sign-in, no application submission, no form submission. The agent effectively stopped after working within a single listing (despite not completing extraction). Baseline full credit stands.
